ios.subtitle: Cheap Business & First Class Deals
ios.description:
Find the cheapest Business and First Class airline tickets worldwide. PremiumFlights searches across all major airlines to bring you the best premium cabin deals — saving you thousands on luxury travel.

WHY PREMIUM TRAVELERS LOVE US:

• SEARCH ALL AIRLINES — Compare Business and First Class fares from Emirates, Singapore Airlines, Qatar Airways, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, Lufthansa, ANA, and 30+ more carriers worldwide.

• REAL-TIME PRICE TRACKING — Get instant alerts when premium cabin prices drop on your favorite routes. Our smart prediction engine tells you whether to buy now or wait.

• PRICE CALENDAR — See the cheapest days to fly at a glance. Flexible date search finds deals ±3 days from your preferred dates.

• CABIN COMPARISON — Side-by-side Business vs First Class comparison showing price difference, amenities, seat type, baggage, and value score.

• MILES & POINTS CALCULATOR — See how many frequent flyer miles you'll earn on each flight across 20+ loyalty programs.

• AIRPORT LOUNGE FINDER — Discover premium lounges at your departure and layover airports with amenities, ratings, and access rules.

• TRIP PLANNER — Organize your entire journey with flights, hotels, transport, and activities in a beautiful timeline view.

• FLIGHT TRACKER — Real-time flight status with departure/arrival updates, gate information, delays, and live tracking.

• VISA CHECKER — Instantly check visa requirements for your destination based on your passport nationality.

• SMART ALERTS — Set price targets and get notified the moment fares drop below your budget.

• OFFLINE MODE — Access your saved flights, trips, and recent searches even without internet.

Save thousands on Business and First Class flights. Download PremiumFlights today and fly premium for less.
